Container.Name: LaserLog
Container.Overview: Self-hosted laser cutter and engraver settings library. Track machines, materials, proven speed/power/pass settings, material test grids and projects. Installs on Android and iPhone as a progressive web app, works offline, and syncs back to this container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and uploaded photos live here.

Config.Name: Laser files (read-only)
Config.Description: Your existing laser files — point this at your Nextcloud user's files folder (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/nextcloud/data/chris/files). Mounted read-only: LaserLog catalogues what's there and never changes it. Leave blank if you don't want file indexing.

Config.Name: Authentication
Config.Description: on = username and password (set on first visit). off = no login at all; only sensible on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Max upload MB
Config.Description: Largest photo accepted per upload. Photos are shrunk on the phone before sending.
